main_text.head: IN GALLOS BELLIS CIVI- libus æstuantes.
main_text.p: QVid motus renouas, Gallia, ciuicos? Quid gentis propriæ funera cernere Gestis, delicias pacis, & ocij Longas indocilis pati?
Si te bella iuuant, in tua sit nefas Enses te proprios condere viscera, Ciuilíque domos oppida, flumina, & Agros tingere sanguine.
Quæsitum pro auis ergo laboribus Regnum, poftgeniti seditionibus Vertent indigenis? maximáque imperi Tandem gloria corruet?

Quam non Teutonico soedere firmior Hispanus potuit perdere, nec ferox Anglus, Marte licet sæpe potentior, Nec tristes Italûm doli, Coniurata suis Gallia viribus A se victa ruet? Sævius extero Cives hoste suos immiserabiles Perdet Gallicus heu furor?
Fœdatos patrio sanguine turpiter Natorum gladios, matréque Colchica

page.notes: The initial Q is a decorative woodcut initial; the first word is given as QVid. Some words in the verse are set in italic type throughout; the poem is set in italic, so italics are not marked. Doubtful: "poftgeniti" as printed; "Ciuilíque" and "maximáque" with accents as printed.
